main.description: Makes a scope an organization, with its owners as its first members: asks for its first 'dev.zena-lang.org.members' record, which the registry holds until the 'ownerThreshold' of the scope's owners have attested it, and 'dev.zena-lang.registry.completeChange' writes it. The caller must be an owner of the scope. The scope keeps its DID, its handle and its packages.

scope.description: The scope, by its DID, on this registry.

uri.description: Where the new record will be written, which an attestation names.

cid.description: The new record's CID, which an attestation names.

errors.name: AlreadyAnOrganization
errors.description: The scope is an organization already.
